concerns: Truncated problem/evidence fields (PF=None, EV=None, sentence cut at 'validate expectancy') leave the motivating claim unverifiable
Falsification criterion mismatches the mechanism: a read-only audit cannot be falsified by future exploration-trade PnL
affected_files includes bot/intel/, home of governed runtime artifacts; write scope must exclude intelligent_champion.json and any lifecycle/runtime files
No stated minimum sample size or uncertainty treatment; small-n buckets (validated vs non-validated) will produce noisy expectancy splits that could be over-read
Join fidelity unspecified: matching key between closed trades and firing-decision records, and how runner spread/slippage assumptions are applied, determine whether results are meaningful
No mention of ExperimentRegistry logging, which AGENTS.md requires for every experiment
votes.reason: The core proposal is sound and safely scoped: a retrospective execution-fidelity audit joining the existing trade journal to firing-decision records, labeled by (regime, structure, session, side), with costed expectancy split between validated asia-sell states and all others. It is read-only analytics on already-recorded outcomes, touches no broker path, no live YAML, and no champion artifact. However, the submission has material defects: the 'current_evidence' field is truncated mid-sentence so the claimed motivating finding cannot be verified, the falsification criterion ('negative costed expectancy after exploration trades') describes a forward trading experiment rather than this retrospective audit and therefore does not actually falsify it, and 'affected_files: bot/intel/' is dangerously vague because bot/intel/ contains the governed intelligent_champion.json and runtime state that research processes must never write.
requested_revisions: Restate the full evidence basis untruncated, including the actual counts and expectancy figures behind the claim that the validated set contains only two asia-sell states

Rewrite falsification criteria for the audit itself, e.g.: if validated-matching trades show costed expectancy statistically indistinguishable from non-matching trades (bootstrap CI overlapping zero), the validated-state gate provides no execution edge and the gate design is falsified
Restrict outputs to bot/reports/research/ plus an ExperimentRegistry entry; declare bot/intel/ strictly read-only for this experiment
Specify the exact join key (trade id / decision timestamp + symbol), dedup rules, and cost model source, confirming costs come from the runner's configured spread/slippage assumptions
Add per-bucket sample sizes and bootstrap confidence intervals; require a minimum n per bucket before any conclusion is drawn
Confirm explicitly the audit performs no mt5.order_send() call and no writes outside the declared report paths

concerns: Proposal text and evidence are incomplete.
Decision-to-closed-trade linkage may be ambiguous or incomplete.
Tiny state-specific samples can create misleading expectancy estimates.
Cost/slippage assumptions and OOS split are unspecified.
Affected runtime intel/council paths create unnecessary risk for a research-only audit.
votes.reason: A read-only execution-fidelity audit is appropriate, but the proposal is truncated and lacks a precise data-join definition, sample-size requirements, cost model, and safeguards against using audit findings to alter execution or champion state.
requested_revisions: Provide the complete proposal and exact source schemas/keys used to join decisions and outcomes.
Make the audit read-only and write results only to governed research reports/experiment registry.
Specify minimum sample sizes, confidence intervals, cost assumptions, handling of unmatched records, and an OOS validation protocol.
Confirm no execution configuration, champion artifact, or broker position can be modified by the audit.

concerns: No exact implementation files, data-join rules, sample sizes, or cost/slippage methodology are specified.
"Exploration trades" could imply broker execution by research or AI Council components, which is prohibited.
No explicit ExperimentRegistry requirement or baseline pass-count requirement is included.
The two validated states and acceptance thresholds are not precisely defined.
No leakage, missing-record, duplicate-join, or out-of-sample handling is specified.
votes.reason: The audit is research-appropriate in principle, but the proposal lacks sufficient operational detail and leaves execution boundaries ambiguous. It must demonstrate read-only research behavior, governed DEMO-only execution if exploration trades are involved, and complete experiment recording before testing.
requested_revisions: Specify exact files and implement the audit as read-only; prohibit mt5.order_send() in bot/intel and bot/ai_council.
If trades are executed, require the existing broker-paper runner only, with all DEMO and fail-closed gates verified and exactly one execution owner.
Define the validated states, join keys, inclusion/exclusion rules, sample-size requirements, and net spread/slippage assumptions.
Register the experiment in ExperimentRegistry and preserve rejected results without champion promotion or live-config changes.
Add leakage, missing-journal, duplicate-join, and OOS validation tests, and report pytest baseline and post-change pass counts.
Define quantitative pass/fail and falsification thresholds for costed expectancy and a clear rollback procedure.
